name: Hotel Mödlinger
beschreibung: Hotel Mödlinger is nestled in Söll within the stunning Wilder Kaiser region. Set in a peaceful yet central location beneath the Hohe Salve, this traditionally run hotel offers warm family hospitality. In winter, the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental slopes are within walking distance, while summer brings scenic hiking and biking trails. Facilities include a wellness suite with an indoor pool and saunas and a restaurant serving local specialties.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Mödlinger in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser area provides a family ambiance, an indoor pool, a sauna wellness area, regional dining, and walkable access to SkiWelt.
